description: Issue a fresh HMAC secret for a subscription. The old one stops verifying the instant this returns, so every delivery fails signature checks until the new value is live on the receiving server — do this when the secret may have leaked, and be ready to deploy the new one immediately. Returned ONCE, like on create: give it to the person for their vault, do not echo it back. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.
name: impreza_rotate_webhook_secret
title: Rotate webhook secret
